title: Mine Little Flawless
description: Minecraft mod featuring the characters of Tamers12345! Mainly focuses Flawless Sparklemoon. :)
body:
Mine Little Flawless is a Minecraft mod that features the characters of the humble Tamers12345!

It features the characters, items and places from his My Little Pony, Dandy's World and Sonic Underground series! Befriend multiple characters such as of Flawless Sparklemoon, Bartleby, Arinos, defeat Friendships's minions as well as conquer your own world with such characters!

This mod's purpose is to bring the characters, items and places of Tamers12345's lore into the world of Minecraft. It includes the characters from his Sonic Underground, My Little Pony and Dandy's World parody series!

*This mod is still being developed, and such, bugs are expected. Suggesstions are appreciated and encouraged, as that will grow the development of this lovely Minecraft mod!* :3

## Disclaimer

**This mod is not affiliated nor endorsed with Mojang, Microsoft, Hasbro, and SEGA. The characters in this mod are purely for entertainment only.**

## Credits

The pony skins of Twilight, Trixie (and probably more in the future) is by the wonderful [Community Skin Pack](https://github.com/MineLittlePony/Community-Skin-Pack)!
The appropriate credits are in [this file](https://github.com/MineLittlePony/Community-Skin-Pack/blob/master/pack%20info%20and%20credits.txt).

The Flawless skin is by madi93638.
